source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 7 May 1936, p. 15 ("Ulster election: contests in four wards")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: the seven uncontested divisions and names read from the News-Letter's Ulster nominations report (7 May 1936, p. 15), which prints the complete Belfast Rural Council list

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors. Nominations were received on 6 May 1936. There were contests in Carnmoney (John Davidson and Reginald L. Hamilton) and Jordanstown (Samuel Graham and Herbert Robinson); the results of those two polls were not traced, so only the seven uncontested divisions are recorded here. (A "Dundonald" entry printed under the Belfast Rural heading in the same report is a Castlereagh Rural District division and is recorded there.) Filed on 1936-06-04, the polling day for county council and rural district elections in Co. Antrim that year (confirmed); previously filed under 1936-05-28 (verification 5 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
